llm_response.reason: The website mimics the branding and products of the legitimate luxury brand Demellier, but uses an unofficial domain (demellier.co.it), registered very recently in 2025 with all contact data hidden. There are red flags present such as the use of the word 'official outlet' for discounted luxury items, vague company information, and a privacy policy lacking clear corporate identification. The .co.it domain does not match the real Demellier presence (demellierlondon.com). These characteristics align with common fake online shopping scams that impersonate reputable brands to deceive customers.
